required_signal.freq: Single positive sampling-rate value in Hz

feature_schema.psd: Hann-window Welch, 2500 samples, 50% overlap, constant detrend, density scaling
feature_schema.band_power: sum of PSD bins times frequency resolution for each [low, high) interval

legacy_policy: Missing unit, gain, or reference is recorded as legacy_unspecified. Such clips may be inspected but are not eligible for automatic pseudo-label replay.

quality_control.reject_when: At least 25% of channels are flat or rail-clipped
